result.sourceText: If you join, a computer will assign you by chance to the investigational-tablet group or the placebo group. You have a 50% chance of being assigned to either group. Neither you nor the researcher chooses your group. You may receive a placebo, which contains no active study drug. The investigational tablet is not guaranteed to help you.
result.translation: Katılırsanız, bir bilgisayar sizi şans eseri araştırma tableti grubuna veya plasebo grubuna atayacaktır. Her iki gruba atanma şansınız %50'dir. Ne siz ne de araştırmacı grubunuzu seçer. Etken madde içermeyen bir plasebo alabilirsiniz. Araştırma tabletinin size yardımcı olacağı garanti edilmez.
result.backTranslation: If you participate, a computer will randomly assign you to the research tablet group or the placebo group. Your chance of being assigned to either group is 50%. Neither you nor the researcher chooses your group. You may receive a placebo containing no active ingredient. It is not guaranteed that the research tablet will help you.
